# MotelyJAML — Copilot Instructions

Balatro seed-filter engine. JAML (Jimbo's Ante Markup Language) is a YAML-based DSL describing which Balatro seeds satisfy joker/boss/item/tag criteria. The C# core compiles JAML into SIMD-vectorized seed filters; tooling (LSP, VS Code extension, MCP server) serves editor support and LLM integration.

## Architecture

```
Motely/                      # Core C# filtering engine — SIMD, JAML compilation
Motely.CLI/                  # NativeAOT CLI (Linux/Windows x64) with AVX/AVX-512
Motely.BrowserWasm/          # Bootsharp WASM → publishes motely-wasm npm (NativeAOT-LLVM, embedded binaries)
Motely.TUI/                  # Terminal.Gui UI (Windows-focused)
Motely.DistributedWorker/    # Pool worker for distributed search
Motely.HelperAPI/            # Auxiliary REST API
Motely.DB/                   # DuckDB interface; Motely.DB.Browser for WASM variant
Motely.Tests/                # xunit test suite (net10.0)
Motely.TestWebsite/          # Vite + React demo site
tools/jaml-language/         # TypeScript monorepo: core | lsp-server | vscode-extension | monaco | jaml-schema
tools/jaml-mcp/              # Standalone MCP server + MCP Apps UI for JAML search
MotelyData/                  # DuckLake seed data files
JamlFilters/                 # User/example .jaml filter library
```

**Version:** 9.9.9 (set in `Directory.Packages.props`).  
**Target framework:** net10.0 (net10.0-browser for WASM).

## Build & Test

```powershell
# Full build + WASM + package
.\publish.ps1

# Individual steps
dotnet build Motely.sln -c Release
dotnet publish Motely.BrowserWasm -c Release
dotnet test Motely.sln
dotnet run --project Motely.CLI -- --write-jaml-schema   # regenerate jaml.schema.json

# Cleanup
.\clean.ps1
```

```bash
# JS/TS tooling (tools/jaml-language/)
cd tools/jaml-language && pnpm install && pnpm build
pnpm dev:lsp        # watch LSP server
pnpm dev:vscode     # watch VS Code extension

# MCP server
cd tools/jaml-mcp && pnpm install && pnpm build

# Root npm scripts
npm run dev                             # Motely.TestWebsite dev server
npm run test:motely-direct-contract
npm run test:motely-wasm-compat-contract
```

## Key Conventions

- **SIMD-first**: Core search uses `MotelyVectorSearchContext` (8 seeds/cycle via AVX/AVX2/AVX-512). Single-seed analysis uses `MotelySingleSearchContext` (partial classes per domain).
- **NativeAOT safety**: Trim-safe via `TrimmerRoots.xml`; use `Vecc.YamlDotNet.Analyzers.StaticGenerator` for YamlDotNet source gen. Don't add reflection-heavy patterns to core/CLI.
- **JAML schema is generated**: `jaml.schema.json` at root and `public/jaml.schema.json` are generated by CLI — do not edit manually.
- **Dual npm output**: `motely-wasm` (full, includes schema/Monaco) vs `motely-wasm-compat` (minimal, index.mjs + types). Keep compat package lean.
- **Database**: DuckDB via `Motely.DB`. Browser variant (`Motely.DB.Browser`) uses duckdb-reader.js interop.
- **JAML syntax source of truth**: `Motely/Filters/Jaml/JamlConfig.cs` and the generated `jaml.schema.json` define the full root/clause/source key surface. Keep language tooling and MCP normalization logic in sync when `JamlClauseDto`, `JamlSourcesDto`, or `JamlSchemaGenerator` change.
- **Jummy**: compact alternative syntax for JAML (compiled by `JummyCompiler`). Tests in `JummyCompilerTests.cs`.
- **Test filters**: `.jaml` files under `Motely.Tests/filters/` are copied to test output and used for regression/RAG embedding.
- **MCP server** (`tools/jaml-mcp/`): standalone HTTP/stdio MCP server plus MCP Apps UI for JAML search.

## Key Files

| Purpose | Path |
|---------|------|
| JAML JSON schema | `jaml.schema.json` |
| Core JAML token definitions | `tools/jaml-language/core/src/index.ts` |
| LSP server | `tools/jaml-language/lsp-server/` |
| VS Code extension entry | `tools/jaml-language/vscode-extension/src/extension.ts` |
| MCP server entry | `tools/jaml-mcp/api/server.ts` |
| MCP tool registration | `tools/jaml-mcp/api/tools.ts` |
| Vector search | `Motely/MotelyVectorSearchContext.cs` |
| Single-seed search | `Motely/MotelySingleSearchContext.cs` |
| JAML compilation | `Motely/` (filter compilation entrypoints) |
| Package versions | `Directory.Packages.props` |
| Shared build props | `Directory.Build.props` |
| Publish pipeline | `publish.ps1` |

## Tooling Notes

- `agent-prefs.json` (`.llms/agent-prefs.json`) declares this workspace is used with **claude-code** and **cursor**.
- VS Code extension debug: open `tools/jaml-language/vscode-extension` and press `F5`.
- Extend JAML keyword coverage in `tools/jaml-language/core/src/index.ts`.
- Build the MCP App bundle before running `tools/jaml-mcp` locally.
- Live demo: https://optimuspi.github.io/MotelyJAML/
